description: This Java class defines a data structure for representing pairs of brackets (such as parentheses, square brackets, braces, and angle brackets). It provides predefined static instances for common bracket types, constructors, and getter methods for open and close characters, as well as a toString method.

classes.name: BracketPair
classes.description: Represents a pair of brackets with specified open and close characters, and includes some predefined static pairs.

methods.name: BracketPair
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a BracketPair with specified open and close characters.

methods.name: getOpen
methods.description: Returns the open bracket as a String.

methods.name: getClose
methods.description: Returns the close bracket as a String.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string concatenation of open and close brackets.
